minister of external affairs, speaking
at the inauguration of the embassy of
Honduras in New Delhi. In this powerful
speech, he celebrates a new chapter in
India Honduras relations, shares a
vision of global cooperation and
highlights opportunities in trade,
technology, and mutual development.

Enrique Rea Garcia, Minister of Foreign
Affairs and International Cooperation of
the Republic of
Honduras. Excellencies, distinguished
guests, ladies and gentlemen, very good
afternoon to all of you. It is a great
privilege to join you all today for the
official inauguration of the Embassy of
the Republic of Honduras in New Delhi.
This occasion marks a significant
milestone and opens up a promising new
chapter in the warm and longstanding
relationship between our two
countries. Minister, let me first uh
acknowledge the statement of solidarity
that we heard from your country on the
cowardly terrorist attack in Palam. Uh
and we particularly value uh your public
commitment to opposition to terrorism uh
in all its forms and the fact that it is
something which is completely
unacceptable uh to uh any form of uh
civilized world.
uh we very much appreciate uh your
support and solidarity as we battle
terrorism uh today in our
region. Where the opening of this
embassy is concerned, I regard it as
more than a ceremonial event. It is a
testament to the shared vision and
mutual commitment of our two nations to
deepen our bilateral ties to fortify our
institutional linkages and to expand the
frontiers of our
cooperation. It reflects our common
aspiration to forge partnerships not
just with Honduras but with the larger
region. relationships that transcend
geography and embody the values of
mutual respect, solidarity and shared
progress. Excellencies, dear friends,
since the formal establishment of
diplomatic relations between India and
Honduras on the 28th of September 198
1994, the our relationship has grown
steadily across multiple dimensions,
political, commercial, developmental and
cultural. Our engagements have been
guided by a spirit of friendship and a
strong belief that international
cooperation serves the broader interests
of
humanity. In the last three decades, our
economic engagements have grown
steadily. They've been underpinned by
trade, by investment, uh by technical
cooperation. Bilateral trade is today uh
a little in excess of $300 million, $310
to be exact. And we have a diversified
basket which includes pharmaceuticals,
textiles, automoils and machinery while
we import coffee, wood and leather from
Honduras.
Now this commercial exchange highlights
the uh considerable potential that
exists uh in areas such as agri
business, renewable energy, healthcare,
information technology, manufacturing.
In fact, minister all the areas that we
discussed today in our very productive
talks earlier in the afternoon. We
recognize
uh the need today to strengthen our
businessto business linkages to foster
greater investment partnerships and to
explore complimentarities while while
exchanging
experiences where Indian companies are
concerned. I do want to recognize that
they have been they have a particular
interest in renewable energy and IT
enabled service sectors. Uh we think
that your country's strategic location
uh its favorable investment climate and
its demand for sustainable solutions
make it an attractive
destination.
Recently Hondaell which is your national
telecom operator had signed a memorandum
of understanding with one of our major
telecom players Reliance Geo paving the
way for the rollout of a 5G network uh
in Honduras. This collaboration marks a
significant step in digital connectivity
partnership as well as in technology
innovation. I'm very confident that the
opening of the embassy of Honduras in
New Delhi will go a long way to
facilitate trade promotion, will
encourage business people to use the
embassy as a hub for matchmaking that it
will provide institutional support to uh
undertake greater initiative, activities
and engagements.
I also want to share on this occasion
the discussions that we've had today and
I think some of our earlier meetings as
well. The fact that as part of global
south uh cooperation uh we have the
possibility of exchanging developmental
experiences. Uh we particularly focused
I think on health. uh and uh also uh the
uh I want to mention that we are now
engaged uh in installing an early
warning system uh which is developed by
C do which is aimed at uh strengthening
Honduras's preparedness for disaster
resilience. Our collaboration on the
global stage has found many meaningful
expressions including in the United
Nations. uh we very much uh value the
consistent support uh that we uh receive
from Honduras in various multilateral
activities. I also want to mention the
Indian diaspora in Honduras. Uh it is
small but it is vibrant and it
contributes significantly uh to uh the
local economy as well as serves as a
living bridge of friendship. Uh we are
very encouraged today to see the
enthusiasm for Indian culture in
Honduras. Uh widespread interest in yoga
in traditional Indian wellness
practices. Uh and again I'm sure that
the establishment of an embassy here uh
would serve to uh to make that living
bridge that much more
effective. Uh let me again uh stress
this broader engagement today that India
has with Latin America and the
Caribbean. I think it has seen
considerable progress uh in the last few
years. Uh when I became minister 6 years
ago, uh I promised many of you or your
predecessors uh that it is certainly a
region in which uh we would take much
greater interest, invest much deeper
energies and have much more activity. To
me, the opening of an embassy uh here uh
is an affirmation that this effort that
we have made uh is actually uh paying
off that uh the embassy or resident
embassy uh is actually a commitment by
Honduras to really uh realize the full
potential of our ties and there is so
much that we can uh do here uh do in
terms of business as I said do in terms
of education, capacity building. Uh our
ITC program has already been active for
many years uh in Honduras. Uh and uh we
can we certainly uh hope that it is
something which would uh grow both in
its quality uh and in terms of the
importance of its contribution. So once
again uh let me uh minister uh wish you
and uh your team and uh your wife uh uh
very uh uh all the best uh on this
important occasion. Uh we really really
appreciate the opening of a resident
mission. Uh we see this as one more uh
step in solidifying our relationship uh
with the region. So, I'm sure many of uh
our colleagues from Latin America would
also join me uh in welcoming the opening
of a resident mission. Uh once again, my
warmest congratulations and I hope that
your presence here today and the opening
of a resident mission uh will uh create
the basis for much more intensive
interactions between us in times to
come. Thank you very much.
